name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Galactic Punch
description:
Blast off with Double-Stacked Galactic Punch Bitez. Each 2-count bag features a massive 1,000mg per gummy, precision-blended with Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP for a cosmic experience. These dual-layer treats fuse deep, velvety blackberry with a vibrant, classic fruit punch finish. Engineered for the heavy hitter who craves a complex, sweet flavor profile. Add this interstellar powerhouse to your rotation today!

Galactic Punch layers juicy Blackberry with bold Fruit Punch flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
